name: TeX Live
summary: TeX, LaTeX, pdfTeX, XeTeX, LuaTeX and MetaPost: TeX Live's small scheme

modules.name: texlive
build: cd "$PREFIX" && sed -i -E '1s/ (on|written on) [A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]+ [0-9:]+ [0-9]{4}( UTC)?$//' texmf-dist/web2c/fmtutil.cnf texmf-dist/web2c/updmap.cfg texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.dat texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.def texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.dat.lua tlpkg/texlive.profile

cd "$PREFIX" && ! grep -l -E ' [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} [0-9]{4}' texmf-dist/web2c/fmtutil.cnf texmf-dist/web2c/updmap.cfg texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.dat texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.def texmf-var/tex/generic/config/language.dat.lua tlpkg/texlive.profile

sed -i -e 's/^    require Win32::Shortcut;$/    eval { require Win32::Shortcut;/' -e 's/^    Win32::Shortcut->import( qw( SW_SHOWNORMAL SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE ) );$/    Win32::Shortcut->import( qw( SW_SHOWNORMAL SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE ) ) };/' "$PREFIX/tlpkg/TeXLive/TLWinGoo.pm"

sed -i -e 's/\$switchit = 1 if (-w "\$TEXMFSYSVAR\/web2c");/$switchit = 1 if (dir_writable("$TEXMFSYSVAR\/web2c"));/' -e 's/} elsif (-d \$TEXMFSYSVAR && -w \$TEXMFSYSVAR) {/} elsif (-d $TEXMFSYSVAR \&\& dir_writable($TEXMFSYSVAR)) {/' "$PREFIX/tlpkg/TeXLive/TLUtils.pm"
